messages:
devon: Strato just pinged — multiple 429s + high p95 latency during a mid-morning campaign burst. Baseline qps ~120, peak ~1.1k for ~3m. They say dedicated pool responded with throttles, not 5xx. Logs attached. :eyes:
amy: on it. can you paste a short log snippet here? any recent config changes for that customer?
kevin: I pulled the pool config: reserved_size=3 replicas (p4-like), min_replicas=1, max_replicas=6, scale_window=60s, scale_up_threshold=70% utilization, burst_capacity enabled but with burst_limit=2x. No infra deploys last 24h.
maria: past week their average token-per-request went up ~x1.4 due to longer prompts (marketing templates). That increases request processing time and reduces effective QPS capacity.
devon: here's the user's error log (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z 429 POST /v1/generate  payload_id=abc123 qps=980 pool=strato-resv-3 replica=rep-2
2026-03-17T09:12:04Z 200 POST /v1/generate  payload_id=abc124 qps=485 pool=strato-resv-3 replica=rep-1 latency=720ms
2026-03-17T09:12:05Z 429 POST /v1/generate  payload_id=abc125 qps=1100 pool=strato-resv-3 replica=rep-2
```
kevin: those 429s line up with per-replica queue explosion. rep-2 shows hot tail. I think noisy-tenant effect: one replica handling higher-cost prompts. Current autoscaler uses aggregate metrics so a few overloaded replicas can still produce 429s until scale decisions kick in.
autoscale-bot: [09:13:10] scale_event: replicas 3 -> 4 reason=scale_up utilization=78%
auto: [09:13:40] scale_event: replicas 4 -> 5 reason=manual_burst burst_token_used=1
amy: thanks. customer is asking for short-term mitigation + long-term sizing advice.
kevin: short-term mitigation options (doable within 10-20m):
- increase min_replicas to 2 so under sustained spikes we already keep more headroom
- increase scale_up aggressiveness: reduce scale_window to 30s and lower threshold to 60%
- temporarily raise burst_limit to 3x (careful on billing)
- enable per-tenant request shaping to spread heavy requests across replicas (if enabled for them)
These combined should cut 429s quickly. :thumbsup:
maria: long-term: bump reserved size to 5 for their committed contract if they want predictable SLA over marketing spikes. Also recommend prompting engineering to reduce avg tokens or pre-generate templates where possible.
devon: customer wants repro steps so they can run a local validation before we change pool config. can we give them a script?
kevin: share this curl-based load repro (small and safe):
```
for i in $(seq 1 200); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"xlarge","input":"<long marketing prompt>"}' & done
```
kevin: recommended acceptance criteria: simulate burst to 1k QPS for 2-3m. If 429 rate >1% with current pool, then undersized.
amy: logged a support action: ticket #INC-2026-874. Proposed immediate action: apply short-term config changes (min_replicas=2, scale_window=30s, scale_up_threshold=60%) and monitor for 30m, then revert if noise appears. If still noisy, propose upgrade to reserved_size=5.
ops-notify-bot: [09:25] audit: applied config change min_replicas=2, scale_window=30s, scale_up_threshold=60% by amy (support) — will auto-monitor 30m
kevin: after the change, we saw fewer 429s within 6 mins and p95 improved from ~980ms -> ~420ms. Still seeing rep-hot events but reduced.
maria: note: cost estimate for reserve bump to 5 is +42% monthly for this pool. share that with customer when proposing.
devon: customer asked about noisy neighbor detection — can we add a per-replica heavy-request heatmap to the console?
kevin: tracked as product request. will add proposal to backlog: "per-replica request heatmap + tenant-level cost attribution".
amy: customer accepted short-term change and will test with the repro script. keeping ticket open until 24h without recurrence.
devon: thanks team. I'll follow up with Strato CS and cc pricing. :white_check_mark:
